mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate at or below 0.2% indicates active monetary accommodation that lowers risk-free rates, increasing equity valuation multiples and producing positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns as capital flows shift toward equities.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.2% (p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate decline below 7.0% (UNRATE < 7.0%) signals labor market tightening that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE < 7.0% (p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous month-over-month increases in housing starts (HOUST > 0.5% MoM) and retail sales (RSAFS > 0.5% MoM) indicate accelerating consumer demand, generating positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns through sustained economic expansion.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST and RSAFS both increase (p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth above 100 (INDPRO > 100) indicates manufacturing sector expansion that increases corporate output and profit margins, yielding positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO > 100 (p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 > 0.5% QoQ) reflects broad-based economic expansion that increases corporate earnings visibility, producing positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 > 0.5% QoQ (p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% (CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%) triggers central bank rate hike expectations that increase discount rates and reduce equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% (p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent payroll growth (PAYEMS > 0.5% MoM) and unemployment decline (UNRATE < 0.3% MoM) indicate robust labor market conditions that strengthen consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, generating positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS > 0.5% MoM and UNRATE < 0.3% MoM (p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 6.5%) create a supportive monetary-labor environment that reduces cost of capital and boosts equity market participation, yielding positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and UNRATE < 6.5% (p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).
